author: /root/p1319_tests
status: Concrete independent inputs/assertions for translation; not sealed, not compiled and NOT_EXECUTED_PRESEAL. Not an exhaustive inventory claim.

operation_semantics.eval_binding: Evaluate once in the real fixture scope using pinned parser/eval entry.
operation_semantics.clone_binding: Clone the already-created real Value without reevaluating its expression.
operation_semantics.float_bits: Construct Value::Float(f64::from_bits(the specified u64)), preserving all64bits.
operation_semantics.source: Create real parsed Source with declared exact text and stable FileId.
operation_semantics.args_literal: Construct Value::Args with ordered items/named, exact span and occurrences; evaluate value expressions in the same real scope. None and Some(empty) are distinct.
operation_semantics.source span: Use the actual parsed node span matching the byte range; missing or ambiguous node is a binding gap, never synthesize a detached span.
operation_semantics.located_content: Construct Value::LocatedContent using real IntrospectedContent::new, Content from binding, declared None/ordered Some fields and actual shared Location token.
operation_semantics.dynamic_callout: Use only existing test CalloutElem::new and Content::dynamic; no handwritten DynElement, dyn_eq or shadow relation.

rules: Port delegates actual private relation used by ordinary context validation. It never computes an independent relation.
Preserve actual discriminant; public false cannot identify Different versus Unproven.
Every supported case must yield the exact asserted discriminant; Unproven cannot satisfy a supported positive.
Opaque control requires actual private Unproven plus separate public validation never Ok(true); no positive semantic coverage credit.
Complete structural witnesses for unexercised variants/fields and unresolved inventory remain separately required before seal.
